cases.question: same slot, different principal
cases.reason: Approved replacement preserves logical slots but renews qualified process/enrolment instances; numeric UID change is not promised.

cases.question: different slot, different principal
cases.reason: Concurrent different native slots require distinct qualified principals/UID/birth subjects under I13. This alone is not an O8 transition.

cases.question: same principal, credential state changed
cases.reason: No exact O8 constituent or state-change criterion designated; cannot infer it from a key/reference alone.

cases.question: different principal, credential state unchanged
cases.reason: Object designation does not establish which state is compared; logical role/public metadata continuity is not full O8 equality.

cases.question: principal relation changes but O8 does not
cases.reason: I13 is separate, but exact O8 equality/persistence is unestablished. Do not turn the distinction into a claimed concrete state model.

cases.question: O8 changes but principal relation does not
cases.reason: Independent semantic dimensions exist, but O8 state extent and equality criterion are not fixed here.
